description: Shared-base contracts between texture masters. A derivative copies a base master's background verbatim and lays its own geometry on top; the copied sections must never drift. Verified by tools/lib/base-sync.mjs, gated at build time in tools/build.mjs and covered by tools/test/base-sync.test.mjs.

block/stone.svg.description: Stone master. Every stone-variant ore overlays its mineral geometry on an untouched copy of this file's striation grooves, so the groove definitions (with their corner radii) and the groove placement group must be identical in each derivative or ore blocks stop blending with surrounding stone in caves.
